notes.title: 🧼"The Big Wash"💰 Update is here!
notes.content:
Hey there, Cleaners!


Today we are releasing our second major content update -🧼"The Big Wash"💰 update! Yay!

Huge thanks to everyone who tested on the Experimental Branch. Your reports and suggestions helped us tune balance, fix issues, and polish the new systems for this release.

If you enjoy the update, please consider leaving a Steam review. It really helps! You can also share feedback on our Discord and on the UpVote Board.


[previewyoutube="ETzndeJEx2s;full"][/previewyoutube]

🚀All the features planned for this update are done🚀


  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/a596b62c2a42c95ba955eb45426bae0692b5cc09.png"]


Full Patch Notes🔧 Key Improvements
The new Industrial Washing Machine: it removes any type of dirt using one of three special chemicals (Detergents) and can be used like a regular washer. Check the usage guide printed on the top panel. Don’t forget a coin to pay for a run.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/738ebcf02373deda65a84a5f8768c8caae7f2b91.gif"]



It can also wash dirty containers. Remember to dry them after washing.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/73d24ba332e118791f4d878ecf64f6147eb5afbf.gif"]



Added new consumables for the Industrial Washing Machine called Detergents, used to clean different types of dirt. Pour a Detergent into the dedicated slot and watch it work.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/2543898747b919eab1b8353dbae8a69a3e83a98c.gif"]



New consumable for the Workbench called Foam Sprayer. Three types are available depending on what you want to clean. The foam can dissipate and clean items automatically, or you can use a Sponge to speed it up. Once delivered it appears at the Workbench and can be refilled.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/820bddca024cf5c6ba0214eca4fa79d5f216d466.jpg"]



You can wash marked money with a Foam Sprayer at the Workbench or with a Detergent in the Industrial Washing Machine.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/2c27ab1b4ef17d0e1370b2a4c0b95e53988a5576.gif"]



A new chemical dirt type called Goo. To clean it, you need the anti-Goo Detergent or Foam. It is very rare and starts appearing after level 17.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/ab2e088ef22e10673d6565900e64ba1d16e7d64b.jpg"]



Sponge is now a consumable. You can buy extras. It wears down in stages and is available from the very start at the Workbench.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/e49ff498976eafbbceac546775260f7b7400519d.gif"]



Added a new rare Container type called Barrel.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/07ebff54d7b657045ee2d6cca51ec9d996da266b.jpg"]
🛠️ Other minor changes
Added hotkey V to close the Scanner.

Updated visuals for the Shopping Cart.

Set the Workbench to a new position and a new startup loadout when starting a new game (for smoother progression for new players).

Added a few more sounds and general audio improvements.

Minor adjustments to the Quest Generator system.

Added some optimizations for the Workbench when handling large amounts of money.

Optimized coin visuals and introduced new coin icons
🐛 Bug Fixes
Fixed visuals for some types of containers.

Fixed some random issues where the Scanner showed false information about object status (dirty, inked, etc.).

Fixed some physics issues for Money Counters.

Minor optimizations for in-game 3D content.

Optimizations for performance when many Money Sorters are on screen.

Fixed a burning issue with the Furnace.

Minor localization and UI fixes in FR, RU, ES.

Fixed the issue where Scanner and Phone could be open simultaneously.

Fixed the issue where empty containers displayed money and items.

Fixed incorrect color display for containers.



Thank you for every Wishlist, bug report, and idea. Have fun with 'The Big Wash'!



– The Cash Cleaner Team 💸

[p align="start"]Another Forklift-published game still has its demo up. An improved version is already in the works. It might be your thing 👇🏻

notes.title: [Experimental] Update 1.2.1.323 Now Live!
notes.content:
🚧 Experimental Branch Update – Try at Your Own Risk!

Hello Cleaners!
We want to thank you for all the feedback after our last update. It has been incredibly valuable and helped us shape a set of adjustments and improvements that now need testing.

If everything works as intended, we plan to move this update to the main branch next week so everyone can enjoy the new features.

👇🏻 Jump in, try out the build, and let us know your thoughts on Discord or right here in the comments. We’ll be reading everything, and your feedback helps us keep polishing the game!



⚠️Please note that it may be unstable. Make sure to back up your save files before playing and proceed at your own risk⚠️


🔧 Key Improvements
Sponge is now consumable. You can buy extras, it has multiple stages, and it is available from the very start on the Workbench.

Added a new rare Container type: Barrel.

Added hotkey V to close the scanner.

Added original sounds for the Industrial Washing Machine.
🧽 Other Minor Changes
Minor adjustments to the Quests Generator system.

Updated sounds for the Foam Sprayer on the Workbench and the Detergent Canister for the Industrial Washing Machine.

Foam and Detergent for cleaning marks are now much more expensive.

Plus optimizations for the Workbench when handling large amounts of money.

Improved visuals and UX for the Industrial Washing Machine.

Added icons for Detergent Canisters.

Added new Coins icons.
🐛 Bug Fixes
Fixed coins visuals.

Optimizations for performance when many Money Sorters are on screen.

Fixed cases where part of the money in the Washing Machine was not being washed.

Fixed burning issue with the Furnace.

Minor localization fixes in FR, RU, ES.

Fixed issue where Scanner and Phone could be open simultaneously.

Fixed minor money counter UI issue.

Fixed Travel Bag state when full of money.

Fixed multiple positioning issues with Detergent Canisters.

Fixed issue where empty containers displayed money and items.

Fixed incorrect color display for containers.

Various small UI fixes.
🔊 Known Issue
We’re aware of a sound bug with Detergent Canisters: if you pick one up while it’s playing its bubbling sound, the effect can get stuck and follow you around. Reloading your save will stop it. This won’t be fixed in today’s update, but a patch is planned.

notes.title: 🏆 We’re a Tiny Teams Champion! Yay!
notes.content:
A few exciting things all at once ✨


We have several lovely things to share today. From festival news to a major milestone and even a chance to meet up in person, it's a great time to be part of the Cash Cleaner Sim crew. Let’s go through it all together.


🌟 We’ve joined Tiny Teams 2025
Cash Cleaner Simulator has been selected for this year’s Tiny Teams, a festival that celebrates games made by solo developers and tiny studios. Even more exciting, we’ve been chosen as a Tiny Teams Champion!

To celebrate, the game is 10% off during the event. If you have been waiting to try it or want to recommend it to a friend, now is the perfect time.



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2488370/Cash_Cleaner_Simulator"][/dynamiclink]
💬 4,000 reviews and counting
We recently crossed 4,000 reviews on Steam, and we are honestly blown away.

Thank you so much for playing, for writing kind (and sometimes hilarious) reviews, and for helping more people discover the game. It truly means the world to us and makes a big difference!


🎉 Visit us at Gamescom
We are heading to Cologne very soon for Gamescom 2025, and we would love to meet you there.
📍 20–24 August | Indie Arena Booth
You can stop by, try out other Forklift games, chat with the team, and pick up some fun, exclusive merch that we are bringing just for the event. You will not find these goodies anywhere else, and we are really excited to share them with you!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/31ff65f05a419f1551d9acdffdd86a0bbb741093.jpg"]


💸 Now part of the Steam Debut Festival
Starting today, Cash Cleaner Sim is also featured in the Debut Festival on Steam, a celebration of new games from first-time studios. We are happy to be included and proud to be part of such a creative lineup.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/9c68937c9edc8f5f0bc8e9554b6f2b1f148234c1.jpg"]



That is all for now. Thank you for being here, for supporting us, and for helping Cash Cleaner Sim grow!



– The Cash Cleaner Team 💸

notes.title: 🔧 QoL Update 1.1.1.185 is here!
notes.content:
Hey there, Cleaners!


We’ve just rolled out a new update for Cash Cleaner Simulator. As always, it includes fixes, improvements, and some extra polish based on your feedback. Scroll down for the full patch notes.

Thanks to your reports and suggestions, we’ve made several tweaks and improvements across the game. Here’s what’s new:


🔧 Improvements
Added more options of Screen resolution in the Graphics Settings menu



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/3db66c95a258a67b2a4c31fcb74af0234d5b4c92.png"]

Updated some counting machine sounds according to your feedback

Significantly improved work of Task Tracker, especially for the end game

Added multiple Localization improvements for all languages

Completed Quests data save optimisations
🐛 Bug Fixes
Fixed rare late game crash on multiple objects on the game level

Add localisation for Save Game

Fixed localization for Settings App in the Smartphone


🔜 Roadmap update
To keep things flowing smoothly, we’ve made a small tweak to the roadmap. One of the future updates has been split into two, which means we now have six updates planned instead of five.

Right now we’re focused on Update 2, and there are no changes to its timing. It’s still on track for release in the second half of August, once we’re back from a short summer break during the first two weeks of the month.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/87fcab0874e08a7806bafae9a01e2741ea45fd8c.jpg"]


🎮 About multiplayer
Since launch, we’ve received many thoughtful suggestions about adding multiplayer. We’ve taken those seriously and discussed the possibilities at length. After carefully evaluating the impact it would have on the game, we’ve decided to keep Cash Cleaner Simulator a single-player title. 

We believe this is the right direction for the game and are excited to keep building on that foundation. Thank you for your interest and for being so engaged.

We’re also continuing to track your ideas on the Feedback UpVote Board. We regularly update the status of suggestions to reflect what’s already been added, what’s currently in development, and what isn’t planned at this time.

Feel free to check the board for the latest updates and keep sharing your thoughts with us. We read and consider every submission.


👀 More news coming next week
We’ve got a few more announcements lined up for next week. Stay tuned!



– The Cash Cleaner Team 💸

notes.title: 🔧 QoL Update 1.1.0.154 is here!
notes.content:
Hey there, Cleaners!
:thumb_up_blue: Big thanks to everyone who jumped into the Experimental Branch, tested the changes, and shared their thoughts. Your input helped us catch major bugs early and polish things up.

This update improves performance, adds some long-requested settings, and smooths out small but important details to make your daily grind a little more satisfying.


🔧 Key Improvements
Major save system improvements Saving is now much faster and produces smaller files. 

New save settings
You can now choose how often the game autosaves, or turn it off completely. A Manual Save button is also available in the ESC menu.

Colorblind mode Added to the Settings menu for better accessibility.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/38387da0208eb67af1d2db20274d5039bb42e03b.gif"]

New smartphone app
Lets you control app notifications and the speed of smartphone animations.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/129b66981af09ee3ea1243c9f7014b66e804f9c6.gif"]

Random quests with marked money
These come with special item names and characters to keep things interesting.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/2f135fede80eae4653560686691f5240b0c97755.gif"]

Fake bill deactivation buttons Added to Money Counters L and XXL to make sorting more convenient.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/c3be22e81dfaa4feacd19c22475c0a9256e5959f.png"]

Heavy object pickup animation
Now you’ll see a short animation when interacting with heavy items, so it’s clear what you’re holding.

Other small improvements

Easier interaction with trash thanks to larger clickable zones

Workbench Sponge cleans faster

Scanner hotkey added for both keyboard and gamepad

Updated logic for “find object” quests

Minor tutorial improvements

Better trash bag sounds

Darknet UI touch-ups

Light switches can now be clicked anywhere, not just on the hand icon

Holding the amount button in the Dark Market will now change values continuously

A small mat has been added next to the workbench

Various UI tweaks
🐛 Bug Fixes
Fixed fatal autosave crashes caused by too many objects

Prevented crashes when changing graphics settings

Story documents can no longer burn by accident

Fixed an issue where marked money could fall through objects

Coin visuals are now correct on all graphics settings

Improved heavy object pickup behavior

Cleaned up washing machine visuals

Adjusted story quest order to avoid blockers

Fixed MoneyGun sound issues

Fixed a dark visuals glitch near the Workbench

Resolved visual issues with the Marked Money Compendium

Fixed minor localization issues


📚 Check out Community Wiki
Our players are actively building a community wiki full of helpful info. We're not involved in maintaining it, but we truly appreciate the effort. If you’d like to join the volunteers, head over to the dedicated Wiki chat in our Discord server and help keep it growing.



Have an idea or suggestion? Share it on our Feedback UpVoteBoard. And if you're not yet part of our cozy and growing community, come hang out with us on Discord!



– The Cash Cleaner Team 💸

notes.title: "The Quality of Crime" Update is here! 💰
notes.content:
Hey there, Cleaners!
Huge thanks to everyone who jumped into the Experimental branch and helped us test the new features over the past few weeks. Your feedback, feature upvotes, bug reports, and wild money-laundering setups helped shape this update once again.


[previewyoutube="s-eRKGGvoI8;full"][/previewyoutube]

🚀All the features planned for this update are done🚀
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/957abb797b0cdf1b83e7e37406c58d10083366a9.jpg"]
🛠️ New Tools & Features
Marked Money Sorting Machine. No more manual UV scanning. This new machine automatically filters out marked bills, saving you time and stress in the late game.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/2dff23a6daf9a53add597110e1e9751cd5ac0014.gif"]

Yen Currency Sorting Machine. Got overseas clients? You’re now equipped to handle Japanese Yen with its own dedicated sorting machine.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/200f037e4915bb732271e5ca059907f2460b9119.gif"]

Full gamepad support, now you don’t even touch the keyboard or mouse!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/ccf15ede1884e1ee160211c37926fac78d79ec99.jpg"]

Æther Speaker with Ambient Music. Customize your lab's vibe with a new speaker item. Play ambient background tracks while you work for that perfect criminal chill.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/3d5a10839aebc7b7540d974576f6b21c45560d19.jpg"]

Marked Bills Collection Frame. Found a bill with a unique mark? Now you can frame and display it as a trophy in your lab.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/eac74c26340de8706ae1900d46fca546944f3538.jpg"]
🌍 Localization
Portuguese and Polish Language Support. We're going global! Thanks to our community in Brazil, Portugal and Poland for the love! 
🔧 Improvements
Tutorial quests now show hints based on your current input device or keyboard layout

Trash visuals are now saved correctly, so you can always tell which piece is which

A single money pack can now be wrapped in a block

Throw charge can now be canceled with LMB

You can now choose any skin for any item from any DLC in the Settings

Main Menu updated to display more game info

Random quests can now generate more marked money, depending on context

The old Speaker has been added to the Dark Market (just in case)

Improved descriptions in the graphics settings

Small story improvements

Minor tweaks to various systems
🐛 Bug Fixes
Fixed progress loss when loading levels or money

Dryer no longer takes money from outside the input area

Fixed collision issues between the dryer and other items

Addressed some performance issues (more improvements in progress)

Fixed visual issues with the 10k Yen bill

Fixed multiple localization problems (more fixes coming soon)

Speakers now turn on properly after loading a save

Fixed sound issues with the Money Counter XXL

Fixed various minor sound and music bugs

All money counters can now be burned in the Furnace
[hr][/hr]👠 New DLC: Slay the Look

This pack includes:
Glamoo-r Wash: "Spill the tea, not the glitter! This machine handles your delicates with dramatic flair."

Rubber & Claws: "Beauty isn’t a weakness. It’s a warning. Handle with care, darling."

Sugarblade: "Sweetly sharp, dangerously chic. This isn't just a tool, it's a statement."

Whether you're cleaning dirty money or just flexing your drip, now you can do both!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/6f9d454c9022a9225107871621d5a62d6fa90aaf.png"]



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3795660/Cash_Cleaner_Simulator__Slay_the_Look/"][/dynamiclink]*Note: This DLC contains cosmetic items only and does not affect gameplay.
[hr][/hr]:wow_benji: Over 3000 reviews on Steam
We’ve now crossed the 3000 review mark on Steam, and we’re genuinely grateful. Your feedback, ratings, and thoughtful comments have been incredibly helpful.
